summary_en: €351M (~¥65.2B) tender offer for 100% of AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS AG closed 26 August 2026 with 96.55% acceptance (35.1M shares tendered). Completion conditional on Austrian FDI clearance; as of 25 August, Greek, Romanian FDI and Austrian, German, Turkish competition approvals obtained. Upon Austrian clearance, squeeze-out under Austrian law to achieve 100% ownership planned. Dai Nippon Printing to become majority investor at €10.0/share.
summary_jp: 欧州セキュリティ印刷企業オーストリアカード・ホールディングスの全株式取得。応募率96.55%（3,509万9,096株）。取得価額約351百万ユーロ（約652億円）。オーストリア外資規制クリアランス取得後、スクイーズアウト手続で100%子会社化予定。

summary_en: Dai Nippon Printing announces launch of tender offer for all ordinary shares of AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS AG (Austria-listed; Vienna Stock Exchange and Euronext Athens). Offer price EUR 10.0/share (including dividend). Tender period 10 weeks (2026-06-12 to 2026-08-21, Vienna time). Settlement expected Q2 FY2027, subject to foreign-investment and competition-law regulatory clearance. Target business: payment IC cards, national ID solutions, variable security printing in Europe, Africa, North America.
summary_jp: 大日本印刷がオーストリア上場企業AUSTRIACARD HOLDINGS AG の全普通株式を対象とした公開買付けを開始。買付価格EUR 10.0/株（配当込み）。買付期間10週間（2026年6月12日～2026年8月21日）。決済は2027年3月期第2四半期中を予定、外資規制および競争法に基づく規制当局クリアランス取得が前提。
